acceptance_rule: Implementation/evidence checks and scientific adoption gates have separate status. New tasks, priors and adapters are declared before new confirmation; old failures are retained.

items.available_work: Use an observable-prefix posterior and preregistered rejection policy on the existing finite typed generator; share it with both neural cores and a strong ordinary parser.
items.closure_evidence: Fresh frozen confirmation meets known-answer quality, accepted correctness and known-answer coverage in every registered condition; branch-conditioned erasure results and exact-law checks agree; scorer availability and hidden targets never enter the forward path.
items.scope: Restricted typed task-law interface reliability; the adapter does not establish learned neural uncertainty or a Flow contribution.

items.available_work: Prospective finite joint-state service task with public priors, shared generator identification, actual noisy observations/actions and strong ordinary propagation.
items.closure_evidence: Same-information paired trajectories show a useful state-distribution or state-content association witness with full paid-action costs; dense expm agrees with an independently implemented ordinary solver under the same fitted generator.
items.scope: New finite-domain mechanism witness; original learned-network core-advantage and unknown-generator gates remain separate.

items.available_work: Batch pointwise decoder calls while retaining the same causal stored features, physics, write order and consumed state.
items.closure_evidence: Fresh frozen complete-model timing satisfies all declared workloads with logits, argmax, all parameter gradients and input gradients checked. Ordinary cores receive the same common optimization before any architecture-speed claim.
items.scope: Same-core implementation improvement on the measured CPU; no automatic Flow-over-ordinary or production-performance conclusion.

items.available_work: Re-extract fixed-prefix raw video features using train-only actor-nested selection; keep the same audio/text control and assess actual added video information.
items.closure_evidence: Pinned raw clip provenance, temporal cutoffs, actor exclusion, frozen candidates, equal-control inputs and paired incremental quality/cost all verify.
items.scope: Existing train/historically exposed development actors; these samples cannot provide genuinely new frontend confirmation.

items.available_work: Declare an untouched actor/recording cohort or a separately audited unused dataset and freeze the complete frontend before opening labels.
items.closure_evidence: New raw-data provenance and historical exclusion, sufficient independent participant coverage, modality capability and AVT-minus-AT increment pass the registered gates.
items.scope: This is a new-data requirement; a code fix or repeat of the historical six actors does not supply it.
extra_resources: Access to suitable unused raw recordings or an audited untouched dataset

items.available_work: Prepare fixed workload/ownership and instrumentation contracts, then execute on an actual target deployment host.
items.closure_evidence: Same-condition quality, full end-to-end latency distribution, sustained throughput, measured hardware joules and real recovery/ownership behavior jointly satisfy the adoption contract.
items.scope: CPU seconds, cached-feature head timing and theoretical GPU gains do not fill missing device measurements.
extra_resources: Actual target hardware and attribution-capable energy instrumentation for the specific adoption claim
